verdict.rationale: Riveter's docs mention it 'reads PDFs and images' and combines results with web data (riveter-docs-18), implying some visual-content ingestion, but there is no explicit description of generating captions or text descriptions of images for downstream reasoning by a text-only model. Missing for 10: explicit captioning/description output format, example enrichment showing image-to-text extraction, and any confirmation this text is usable standalone by a text-only model.
